info.title: Arkiv Node API
info.description:
Complete HTTP reference for the signed Arkiv node: native REST, Ethereum-compatible JSON-RPC, state-tree exploration, light-node proof verification, private administration, and optional metrics. WebSocket subscriptions are documented as a transport guide; Scalar's HTTP client cannot execute a subscription session.

Start with GET /signed/v1/status to identify the node role. The same public routes are registered on producer, full and light nodes, but role-specific operations return UnsupportedNodeRole or ProducerOnly when unavailable. Select your light-node server for verified queries; JSON-RPC reads on a light node are forwarded and unverified. Native commitments are not Ethereum MPT roots; this is single-proposer authentication, not Ethereum consensus or finality.

Public HTTP requests use the selected origin without a Scalar request proxy. Private administration and metrics have separate loopback server settings: replace these with an authorized listener/tunnel; they are not exposed by the public docs deployment. Browser mixed-content/CORS restrictions may require curl for a separate listener. Native decimal quantities are strings and binary payloads are 0x-prefixed hex. Most native REST requests are capped at 64 KiB and responses at 8 MiB; state exploration has stricter documented caps. Heights/namespaces in examples are illustrative. Never submit transaction examples without constructing and signing your own valid payload.

post.summary: Execute SDK and Ethereum-compatible JSON-RPC calls
post.description:
Native Ethereum-compatible JSON-RPC over HTTP (also supported over WebSocket at the same path). This is not a complete Ethereum API: hashes are native commitments, not Ethereum MPT roots; arbitrary EVM execution is unsupported. Full/producer nodes read locally; light nodes forward all methods to their peer without proof verification. eth_sendRawTransaction is forwarded by full followers as well. No bearer authentication.

Requests are limited to 1 MiB and responses to 8 MiB. A batch contains 1–64 calls. Notifications omit id and produce no response; all-notification requests return HTTP 204. JSON-RPC errors normally return HTTP 200. Block selectors: latest, pending, safe, finalized (all resolve to the native head), earliest, or hexadecimal height. These aliases do not imply Ethereum finality.

### Supported methods

**`web3_clientVersion`** — Client implementation string.

**`net_version`** — Decimal chain ID string.

**`net_listening`** — Always true.

**`eth_chainId`** — Chain ID as a hexadecimal quantity.

**`eth_blockNumber`** — Latest height as a hexadecimal quantity.

**`eth_syncing`** — Always false; use signed status for native node health.

**`eth_gasPrice`** — Fixed gas price as a hexadecimal quantity.

**`eth_maxPriorityFeePerGas`** — Always 0x0; priority fees are unsupported.

**`eth_accounts`** — Empty list; this node does not manage wallet keys.

**`eth_getBalance`** — Address, optional block selector → balance in wei as a hexadecimal quantity.

**`eth_getTransactionCount`** — Address, optional block selector → nonce; pending includes contiguous pending transactions.

**`eth_getCode`** — Address, optional block selector → 0x. Arbitrary EVM contracts are unsupported.

**`eth_getBlockByNumber`** — Block selector, fullTransactions boolean → native block compatibility object or null.

**`eth_getBlockByHash`** — Block hash, fullTransactions boolean → block object or null.

**`eth_getBlockTransactionCountByNumber`** — Block selector → transaction count as a hexadecimal quantity.

**`eth_getTransactionByHash`** — Transaction hash → committed/pending transaction object or null.

**`eth_getTransactionReceipt`** — Transaction hash → committed receipt object or null.

**`eth_getTransactionByBlockNumberAndIndex`** — Block selector, hexadecimal transaction index → transaction object or null.

**`eth_sendRawTransaction`** — Signed Ethereum transaction bytes → transaction hash. Replace the illustrative 0x with signed EIP-155 legacy or EIP-1559 bytes with an empty access list; forwarded to the producer by full followers and light nodes.

**`eth_estimateGas`** — Call object, optional latest/pending selector → gas estimate. Historical simulation is unsupported.

**`eth_call`** — Arkiv contract call object and optional block selector → ABI result bytes. Replace illustrative data with ABI call data. Only native Arkiv calls are supported; entityNonce supports historical reads, other simulation requires the current head.

**`eth_getLogs`** — Log filter → logs. At most 256 blocks per query; blockHash is mutually exclusive with fromBlock/toBlock.

**`eth_newFilter`** — Log filter → process-local filter ID. Filters expire after 15 minutes without access; maximum 1024 filters.

**`eth_newBlockFilter`** — Creates a block filter and returns its hexadecimal filter ID.

**`eth_uninstallFilter`** — Filter ID → boolean indicating removal.

**`eth_getFilterChanges`** — Filter ID → new logs or block hashes; advances the filter cursor.

**`eth_getFilterLogs`** — Log filter ID → all matching logs within its bounds; block filters are unsupported.

**`eth_feeHistory`** — Hexadecimal block count, newest block selector, optional ascending percentiles (0–100) → oldestBlock, baseFeePerGas, gasUsedRatio, reward. Count capped at 1024; at most 100 percentiles; rewards are zero.

**`arkiv_query`** — Query text and optional options → {data,blockNumber,cursor?}. Options: atBlock (integer or hexadecimal quantity), limit (1–200; default 100), select, cursor. Explicit atBlock required for continuation; cursors are process-local and expire on eviction/restart. Results are unverified.

**`arkiv_getEntityCount`** — Optional options object with block (integer height) and query (text) → JSON integer count. Results are unverified.

**`arkiv_getBlockTiming`** — Returns current_block, current_block_time and duration as JSON integers; times are seconds.

### Result schemas

Block reads return RpcBlock or null; transaction reads return RpcTransaction or null; receipts return RpcReceipt or null. Log reads return arrays of RpcLog; eth_getFilterChanges returns RpcLog[] or block-hash strings. eth_feeHistory returns RpcFeeHistory. arkiv_query returns RpcQueryResult containing projected RpcEntity rows; arkiv_getEntityCount returns an integer; arkiv_getBlockTiming returns RpcBlockTiming. Request variants below describe each method’s positional parameters.

### Entities and query errors

Entities follow the user-defined-columns model: an entity is its system fields plus up to 32 named, typed attributes per create or patch. Bit 7 (0x80) of an attribute's ABI typeId marks it indexed; bytes may never be indexed. Every attribute is stored and returned (attributes, attributeSchema with indexed), but predicates only ever match indexed attributes. There is no payload or content type: $payload and $contentType are unknown, and select rejects payload and contentType.

arkiv_query and arkiv_getEntityCount refusals use the SDK's code table: -32001 parse (data {position, expected, got}), -32002 type, -32003 literal, -32004 limits, -32005 cursor, -32006 block (atBlock above the head or below the retention floor). Malformed parameters are -32602. ServerBusy is -32010.

### State retention

A full node started with --state-retention N serves state only at heights >= stateFloor = head - N (status stateFloor; it never decreases). Reads of older state (eth_getBalance, eth_getTransactionCount, eth_call entityNonce, arkiv_getEntityCount, arkiv_query, including later pages of an arkiv_query cursor) fail with code -32006, message "history pruned: requested N, floor F" and data {requested, floor}. Logs, receipts and block objects of block h (logsBloom) are derived from state h-1, so eth_getLogs, eth_getFilterLogs/Changes, eth_getTransactionReceipt and eth_getBlockByNumber/ByHash refuse blocks below receiptFloor = stateFloor+1 (block 0 is always served); the whole eth_getLogs range is checked up front. Body-only reads (eth_getTransactionByHash, eth_getTransactionByBlockNumberAndIndex, eth_getBlockTransactionCountByNumber, eth_feeHistory, block filters, eth_getCode) are served at every height. A WebSocket subscription whose replay position falls below the floor receives one eth_subscription notification carrying params.error (code -32006) and is closed. Archive retention (the default) serves every height.

200.description: JSON-RPC response or batch responses; inspect error even when HTTP succeeds.

408.description: Request body timed out after five seconds.

413.description: Request body could not be read within the 1 MiB cap.

get.summary: Upgrade to WebSocket JSON-RPC and subscriptions
get.description:
Connect with ws:// or wss:// to / using a WebSocket client; Scalar HTTP Try It cannot establish a WebSocket session. Supports the HTTP JSON-RPC methods plus eth_subscribe and eth_unsubscribe. Supported subscriptions: newHeads and logs (optional address/topics filter only). Notifications use eth_subscription with params.subscription and params.result. Subscriptions are connection-local and start after the sampled current head; no historical replay. 16 connections per process, 16 subscriptions per connection, 1 MiB requests, 8 MiB responses; notification delivery is bounded and lag beyond 128 blocks closes the connection. See RpcSubscriptionRequest and RpcSubscriptionNotification schemas for message shapes.

Example message: `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_subscribe","params":["newHeads"]}`

Unsubscribe: `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"eth_unsubscribe","params":["0x1"]}` returns a boolean.

WebSocket batches contain 1–32 calls (HTTP permits up to 64).

101.description: Switching Protocols; bidirectional JSON-RPC session established.

400.description: Missing or invalid WebSocket upgrade headers.

429.description: All 16 WebSocket connection slots are occupied.

Decimal.description: Unsigned 64-bit integer encoded as canonical decimal text (maximum 18446744073709551615).

Path.description: Root-relative child slots: branch 0–15; extension child 16. Copy children[].path from the preceding response. Smaller per-map key-width bounds also apply.

termPath.description: For postings, the path of a reachable term leaf in the namespace terms tree. Omit or use [] for other maps. An empty path is valid for postings only when the terms root is a leaf.

ExploreRequest.description: Pin every request to a retained height. Catalog requires namespace omitted or null; every other map requires a nonzero namespace ordinal. Unknown fields are rejected.

TypedValue.description: Booleans are JSON booleans. Integers, decimals and the time types are exact decimal text (date32 in days, timestamp64 in microseconds since the Unix epoch; decimals at their fixed scale: dec32 4 places, dec64 6, dec128 and dec 18); floats are shortest round-trip decimal text, inf or -inf (never NaN); byte, address and key values are 0x-prefixed lower-case hexadecimal; strings are plain text.

ValueType.description: Engine scalar type name, in type-id order (ids 1-25). Generic namespaces admit every type; the Arkiv entity namespace admits only the SDK subset.

Cell.description: Strings preview at most 256 characters; bytes at most 32 bytes. byteLength is the original byte length for strings/bytes, otherwise null. Complete values remain in raw node bytes.

Child.description: Only follow nonempty children. Inline children include their embedded RLP; hash references have no inline RLP.

TreeNode.description: One actual trie node. Prefix and compressedPath are hexadecimal nibbles without 0x. Raw records and non-leaf nodes have decoded:null.

ExploreResponse.description: node:null denotes an empty map. Integrity is checked by the full node; this response is not an independently verified browser proof.

DecimalString.description: Unsigned decimal string (not a JSON number).

CanonicalBytes.description: 0x-prefixed hex bytes. Native canonical payloads use the Arkiv binary codec, not JSON or base64.

TypedQueryValue.description: Booleans are JSON booleans. Integers and decimals are decimal strings; binary values and addresses are 0x-prefixed hex strings.

stateFloor.description: Lowest height whose state (balances, nonces, proofs, queries, state tree) is served; lower heights answer HistoryPruned. 0 for archive; it never decreases. null on a light node.

result.description: Result depends on request method; see the method-specific result table and schemas.

code.description: -32700 parse error; -32600 invalid request; -32601 unknown method; -32602 invalid params; 3 execution reverted; arkiv_query/arkiv_getEntityCount refusals use the SDK's table: -32001 parse, -32002 type, -32003 literal, -32004 limits, -32005 cursor, -32006 block (the requested height is outside the retained range: above the head, or below the retention floor on any method, message "history pruned: requested N, floor F"); -32010 ServerBusy (detached-read permits taken; retry); -32011 WebSocket subscription limit; -32000 runtime error.

oneOf.description: HistoryPruned details: requested height and the floor that refused it (the state floor, or for receipts/logs/block objects the receipt floor), as hexadecimal quantities.
Query error location (parse, type and literal errors): the UTF-8 byte offset, the source text found there, and for a parse error what was expected.

RpcQuantity.description: Hexadecimal unsigned integer with no leading zeroes.

miner.description: Native proposer key bytes, not an Ethereum beneficiary address.

RpcBlock.description: Native block in Ethereum-compatible shape. Commitment roots are not Ethereum MPT roots.

miner.description: Native proposer key bytes, not an Ethereum beneficiary address.

RpcReceipt.description: Includes the native transaction compatibility fields plus receipt status, gas and logs.

RpcCall.description: Native call object. from is required for simulation/estimation (except the entityNonce read); data or input carries ABI call data. eth_call supports only the Arkiv address.

value.description: Typed by `type`, never by magnitude: bool as a boolean, i32 as a number, u64/u256 as a hex quantity, dec as decimal text, bytes/bytes32/addr/key as 0x hex, str as text.

attributeSchema.description: Every user attribute's name, type tag and indexing, without values.

indexed.description: true for an indexed attribute (ABI typeId with bit 7 set); false for one that is only stored. Predicates never match an unindexed attribute.

attributes.description: Every selected user attribute, indexed or not, bytes values included.

RpcEntity.description: Projected SDK entity (user-defined columns): only selected fields are returned; key defaults to selected but may explicitly be false. There is no payload or content type.

RpcEntitySelection.description: The SDK's RpcSelect. Unknown keys, including the removed payload and contentType, are invalid params (-32602).

NodeCapabilities.description: Runtime capability report. Simulator and signed nodes share the data and proof fields; signed nodes add gas, sdkRpcProfile and genesisPrefill.

profile.description: Arkiv entity rules served by this node: user-defined columns (per-attribute indexed flag, user bytes, no payload or content type).

valueTypes.description: Every engine value type, in type-id order. bytes is field-only (never indexed).

limits.description: Engine limits fixed by the chain's genesis.

indexedValueBytes.description: Longest indexed str value in bytes.

entityNamespace.description: Rules of the host-controlled Arkiv entity namespace.

valueTypes.description: Arkiv SDK attribute types; every one may be indexed except bytes.

unindexedValueTypes.description: Types that are stored but never indexed: bytes.

indexedTypeIdFlag.description: Bit of the ABI typeId that marks an attribute indexed (0x80).

maxAttributes.description: Most attribute triples per create or patch.

entityBytes.description: Most data the bytes attributes of one entity may hold together.

genesisPrefill.description: Signed nodes: whether the genesis carries a height-zero entity prefill.

gas.description: Signed nodes: the glm-v2 gas profile (GLM pricing, funded accounts, burnt fees).

rentRule.description: Capped rent per second: no operation charges rent past height + maxRentLifetimeBlocks, and charged blocks are priced in time at rentBlockPeriodMs.

rentCharging.description: Rent is a GLM debit from the sender's balance after its gas reservation, burned like fees; it is not gas and counts against neither the transaction gas limit nor the block gas limit. An operation whose rent the sender cannot pay fails with InsufficientRentBalance and its transaction rolls back.

rentWeiPerStorageUnitDay.description: Rent rate: 20 gwei per logical storage unit per day (7,300 gwei per unit per year), rounded up once per operation to the next wei.

rentBlockPeriodMs.description: The genesis block period (ChainParams.block_period_ms) at which charged blocks are priced in time.

maxRentLifetimeSeconds.description: The genesis rent cap (ChainParams.max_rent_lifetime_seconds), 1 s to 100 years; every lifetime at or beyond it, permanent included, costs the same. Default: a year.

maxRentLifetimeBlocks.description: maxRentLifetimeSeconds in whole blocks at rentBlockPeriodMs, rounded up: the cap execution applies.

rentBound.description: Rent is limited only by the sender's balance: a wallet's gas limit times gas price plus value covers the fee and value, not the rent. The pool reserves a rent quote at the larger of the next height and rentQuoteMarginBlocks later; execution charges the real rent.

maxNewStorageUnitsPerBlock.description: The genesis cap (ChainParams.max_new_storage_units_per_block) on the storage units one block's committed transactions add: creates' entities and patches' growth. A producer defers a transaction that would cross it; one that alone exceeds it is refused at admission. Default 1500000, which binds no block the default input cap admits.

rentReceiptField.description: The eth_getTransactionReceipt field holding the rent a committed transaction burned, in wei (hex quantity).

permanentEntitiesSupported.description: Live creates and extensions accept expiresAt = 2^64 - 1.

permanentEntities.description: Rules of u64::MAX (permanent) entities: never scheduled or swept; rent capped; only the owner may extend an entity beyond one rent cap ahead, permanence included (a permissionless-extension entity takes anyone's extension up to height + maxRentLifetimeBlocks; further is PermanenceOwnerOnly); extending a permanent entity to permanent is a no-op success and a finite expiry is ExpiryShortened; genesisRows says whether a permanent-prefill launch holds rent-free sponsored rows.

sdkRpcProfile.description: Signed nodes: the Arkiv SDK JSON-RPC surface.

HistoryPruned.description: State history below the node's retention floor is declared pruned (--state-retention). The refusal is checked before any state access and never falls back to the head. A full node includes the requested height and its current floor; a light node relays its peer's refusal without details. Compare GET /signed/v1/status stateFloor.

PrivateBearer.description: Exact --token-file bearer token on the separately configured --private-listen listener. Never committed or embedded in the docs.
